description:
Port the upstream header/banner from interactive-mode.ts lines 558-619.

**Layout (collapsed — default):**
- Logo line: bold accent `OctoPi` + dim ` v{version}`
- Compact keybinding hints on one line, joined by dim ` · ` separator:
  `Ctrl+C interrupt · Ctrl+L/Esc clear/exit · / commands · ! bash · ? more`
- Dim onboarding line: "Press ? to show full startup help and loaded resources."
- Blank spacer line above and below

**Layout (expanded — toggled by `?` key):**
- Logo line (same)
- Multi-line keybinding hints, one per line:
  `Ctrl+C to interrupt`, `Ctrl+L to clear`, `Ctrl+L twice to exit`,
  `Esc to exit (empty)`, `Ctrl+K to delete to end`, etc.
- Dim onboarding: "OctoPi can explain its own features..."

**Implementation:**
- New module `OctoPi.TUI.Components.Header`
- Pure render function: `render(%Header{}, width) :: [binary()]`
- State holds `expanded :: boolean`, toggled by a key event
- Keybinding hint text uses dim/muted ANSI SGR codes
- Wire into Interactive layout: header lines prepended before transcript

**Upstream ref:** `interactive-mode.ts` lines 558-619, `keybinding-hints.ts`
title: Header component: logo + version + keybinding hints (compact/expanded)
